item.title: Southeast Asia turns to nuclear as Iran war disrupts energy supplies
item.summary: Analysts say the Iran war energy crisis is also adding momentum to nuclear interest and action in the region.

item.title: The U.S. and Iran are in 'indirect talks,' says intermediary Pakistan, as war rages on
item.summary: Pakistan's foreign minister said the country is relaying messages and that Iran is deliberating on a U.S. proposal. Israel says it killed the Iranian Revolutionary Guard's navy chief.

item.title: Trump's attacks on offshore wind could hurt infrastructure spending across the economy
item.summary: President Trump has tried to kill offshore wind's future in the U.S. But industry analysts say the attacks could hurt business confidence across the U.S. economy.

item.title: Decades ago, a Maryland sailor burned his winter socks. Now it's a spring tradition
item.summary: In Annapolis, Md., people gather each year to usher in the warmer weather by burning their socks. The springtime tradition is the unofficial start of the Chesapeake Bay sailing season.

item.title: Bill Maher is getting the Mark Twain Prize after all
item.summary: There was confusion about whether the satirist would be getting the Kennedy Center's top humor award after White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt called it "fake news." Now it's confirmed.

item.title: A $50 billion fund to help rural hospitals could actually lead to closures and cuts
item.summary: States are rolling out plans for their share of a $50 billion fund established by Congress to improve rural health care. In some states, the money may provoke rural hospitals to cut services.

item.title: Hoping to unseat Collins, Maine Democrats battle it out in an expensive U.S. Senate primary
item.summary: As June's primary election nears, Democratic Gov. Janet Mills and combat veteran Graham Platner are effectively engaged in a proxy battle between factions in their own party.

item.title: Sturgill Simpson pulls off an unusual chart feat
item.summary: The roots music maverick did something rare in the streaming era: landed an album that's only available on CD, cassette and LP — without his name on the sleeve — in the top five of the albums chart.

item.title: Suit asks court to force Trump administration to use 'The Kennedy Center' name
item.summary: The motion is part of a lawsuit challenging President Trump and the Center's board, who now refer to the complex as "The Trump Kennedy Center."

item.title: It's Equal Pay Day. Women have lost ground for the second year in a row
item.summary: The annual observance marks how far into the new year women must work to make what men earned in the previous year. This year, it's March 26, a day later than it was in 2025.
